method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Sloan 一下楼就卸下装新书的箱子，并在书架上腾出充足空间摆放。
facts.anchor: Sloan unloaded the box as soon as she came down, having made ample space on one of the shelves for the new books.

facts.fact: Hattie 一直站着没碰她为点心准备、涂了凝脂奶油和果酱的牛角面包，以免陷入白日梦。
facts.anchor: hasn’t touched any of the croissants slathered with clotted cream and jam she fixed for their snack

facts.fact: Sloan 说天气反常，断言今年冬天会很难熬。
facts.anchor: It’ll be a nasty winter, mark my words.

facts.fact: Hattie 回想 Eeling 关于 Julian 的话——不只是想亲近他，而是在监视他。
facts.anchor: It’s not just wanting to be close to him, is it? You’re watching him.

facts.fact: Sloan 打听那个连日来访的黑发男子，Hattie 冲他脱口而出指责他窥探别人。
facts.anchor: Don’t you have anything better to do than spy on people?

facts.fact: Sloan 承认自己爱拿望远镜看人，且因为再也不能游泳而变本加厉。
facts.anchor: Been worse since I can’t swim anymore.

facts.fact: Hattie 向 Sloan 谎称 Julian 是她儿子的朋友——那个虚构的、自杀身亡的孩子。
facts.anchor: He was a friend of my son’s.

facts.fact: Sloan 说 Adam 每次上门都会提醒他这里本该还有另一个缺席的人。
facts.anchor: I’m always reminded there should be someone else here who’s missing.

facts.fact: Hattie 回家看见 Wendy 在门廊等候且满脸泪痕，Wendy 说“他伤了他，很重很重”，并纠正说是 Bastion 而非 Julian 受伤。
facts.anchor: He hurt him. Really, really bad.
